shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the upper marker at x = −1 in the left image with the marker at 3 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The declining branch supplies the included point (−1, 5). Right image: The depicted left-side interval excludes its right endpoint 3.
Rationales: The selected left cue includes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue excludes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
